lesson.title: Nine hundred and fifty years
lesson.hook: Nuh calls his people by night and by day, openly and in private, and few listen (71:5–9; 29:14)

title: night and day
hook: he kept calling. almost nobody listened.
cast: no people in any story shot. today: only the hands of a Black British Muslim teacher in London.
